say:1:1610715001:1.text: Hello! You're students from the Lyceum, right? First time here?
say:1:1610715001:1.source_cn: 你们两位应该也是莱希拉姆的学生吧，第一次光临小店？

choice_prompt:2:1610715001.text: Hello! You're students from the Lyceum, right? First time here?
choice_prompt:2:1610715001.source_cn: 你们两位应该也是莱希拉姆的学生吧，第一次光临小店？

say:3:1610715002:1.text: A first-year! Don't worry, you'll love our drinks!
say:3:1610715002:1.source_cn: 是新生啊……放心，我们店里的饮品保准让你们满意！
say:3:1610715002:1.male: A first-year! Don't worry, you'll love our drinks!
say:3:1610715002:1.female: A first-year! Don't worry, you'll love our drinks!

say:5:1610715005:1.text: Oh, there's so many! "Illusion" has layered flavors for the adventurous. "Magic Garden" is warm, sweet with floral and fruity notes.
say:5:1610715005:1.source_cn: 哎呀，这就多了。“幻觉”有着非常多层次的口味，是求新求...

say:6:1610715006:1.text: If you want something refreshing and balanced, "Sunrise in the Woods". Or the student favorite, "Scarecrow", earthy and rustic.
say:6:1610715006:1.source_cn: 如果喜欢口味清爽、酸甜适中的，“林中日出”绝对合你心意...

say:7:1610715007:1.text: Our friend recommended the Daily Special, they said it's the best drink here.
say:7:1610715007:1.source_cn: 对了，我朋友推荐过一个……呃，对，“每日特调”，说是你...

say:8:1610715008:1.text: I'm sorry, the Daily Special is already sold out.
say:8:1610715008:1.source_cn: 很抱歉，两位客人，每日特调已经售罄了。
say:8:1610715008:1.male: I'm sorry, the Daily Special is already sold out.
say:8:1610715008:1.female: I'm sorry, the Daily Special is already sold out.

say:9:1610715009:1.text: But that's the one I came for!

say:10:1610715010:1.text: My friend said after drinking it, he felt amazing, like his <style="highlight">mana shot up</style> and spellcasting was easier!
say:10:1610715010:1.source_cn: 朋友说喝了你们这里的特调，心情一下子就变得非常好，甚至...

say:11:1610715011:1.text: Mana boost? From a drink? Impossible!
say:11:1610715011:1.source_cn: 啊？魔力上涨？每日特调怎么会有这样的功效！

say:12:1610715012:1.text: Then which drink does it? I'll take that one!
say:12:1610715012:1.source_cn: 那什么饮品有这样的功效？我就要喝那种饮品！

say:13:1610715013:1.text: Dear customer, you must be joking. No drink can raise mana. Your friend must have remembered wrong!
say:13:1610715013:1.source_cn: 客人一定是在开玩笑，怎么会有饮品让魔力上涨呢？你的朋友...

say:14:1610715014:1.text: While Evie chats with him, you quietly observe the barista. You sense something off—his face looks surprised, but his eyes remain disturbingly calm.
say:14:1610715014:1.source_cn: 趁着伊芙套话，你在旁边暗暗观察着酒保。你敏锐地察觉到一...

say:14:1610715014:1.female: While Evie chats with him, you quietly observe the barista. You sense something off—his face looks surprised, but his eyes remain disturbingly calm.

say:17:1610715016:0.text: That's right. I may be a student, but I'm a noble from Savannah. I'm different from the others!
say:17:1610715016:0.source_cn: 没错，同样是学生，但我可是赛凡纳来的贵族，和他们不一样！

say:18:1610715017:1.text: Surely these coins will do. Two cups, name your price.
say:18:1610715017:1.source_cn: 我相信，这些金币很足够了。

say:20:1610715021:0.text: Evie assumes a flawless noble stance, setting a heavy bag of gold coins before the barista—proud, distant, and icy. She's absolutely nailing the performance.
say:20:1610715021:0.source_cn: 伊芙摆出一副贵族架势，将一袋装得满满的金币放在酒保面前...
say:20:1610715021:0.male: Evie assumes a flawless noble stance, setting a heavy bag of gold coins before the barista—proud, distant, and icy. She's absolutely nailing the performance.
say:20:1610715021:0.female: Evie assumes a flawless noble stance, setting a heavy bag of gold coins before the barista—proud, distant, and icy. She's absolutely nailing the performance.

say:21:1610715022:0.text: Is this enough? My father is a close aide to His Majesty himself. He always said that politeness is useful, but never necessary.
say:21:1610715022:0.source_cn: 这些够了吗？我的父亲——他是国王陛下的近身官员——曾教...

say:22:1610715023:1.text: I prefer being courteous. But if we can't buy two drinks even with our status, then politeness ends here.
say:22:1610715023:1.source_cn: 我喜欢礼貌待人，但如果你认为以我们的身份还不能买两杯特...

say:23:1610715024:0.text: You glance at the barista. He doesn't seem intimidated by Evie's display, but instead there's a glint in his eyes, like a predator spotting a prize.
say:23:1610715024:0.source_cn: 你看向酒保，他似乎并不担忧伊芙的威胁，眼中反而闪过一丝...
say:23:1610715024:0.male: You glance at the barista. He doesn't seem intimidated by Evie's display, but instead there's a glint in his eyes, like a predator spotting a prize.
say:23:1610715024:0.female: You glance at the barista. He doesn't seem intimidated by Evie's display, but instead there's a glint in his eyes, like a predator spotting a prize.

say:24:1610715025:1.text: Evie's disguise is clearly working. If anyone were looking to exploit students, a noble magic student from Savannah would be the perfect mark.
say:24:1610715025:1.source_cn: 看来伊芙的伪装很有效果。如果对方对学生有所图谋，“来自...

say:25:1610715026:0.text: I'm terribly sorry, my lady. Our humble shop is honored to serve you.
say:25:1610715026:0.source_cn: 真抱歉，您是位大贵族，小店当然很欢迎您这样的贵客。

say:26:1610715027:0.text: Perhaps then, you'd like to try our <style="highlight">custom service</style>? It's pricier, but I'm sure you wouldn't mind.
say:26:1610715027:0.source_cn: 既然如此，您或许愿意试试<style=highligh...

say:27:1610715028:1.text: A drink <style="highlight">crafted just for me</style>? Perfect. Nobles value uniqueness over all.

say:28:1610715029:0.text: Ah, but... <style="highlight">custom drinks</style> require a reservation.

choice_prompt:29:1610715029.text: Ah, but... <style="highlight">custom drinks</style> require a reservation.
choice_prompt:29:1610715029.source_cn: 只是……<style=highlight>个人定制化饮品</style>是需要预约的。

say:30:1610715030:0.text: I'm terribly sorry. You came unannounced, and our master drinkmaker isn't here. But if you like, I can book you for tomorrow.
say:30:1610715030:0.source_cn: 非常抱歉，两位贵客来得仓促，没有预约，小店的饮品主理人...

say:31:1610715031:0.text: We'll craft your personalized drink and reserve the Daily Special just for you!
say:31:1610715031:0.source_cn: 明天，明天保证一定有——饮品主理人会为二位调制定制化饮...

choice_prompt:32:1610715031.text: We'll craft your personalized drink and reserve the Daily Special just for you!
choice_prompt:32:1610715031.source_cn: 明天，明天保证一定有——饮品制作人会为二位调制定制化饮品，还有，每日特调也可以给二位留着！

say:33:1610715032:1.text: We don't have time tomorrow. It has to be today.
say:33:1610715032:1.source_cn: 明天我们可没空，就今天。

say:34:1610715033:1.text: Um... in that case, esteemed guests, I'll send someone to fetch our drinkmaker right away. Please, wait here a while.
say:34:1610715033:1.source_cn: 呃……两位贵客，这样吧，我现在就派人将我们的饮品主理人...
say:34:1610715033:1.male: Um... in that case, esteemed guests, I'll send someone to fetch our drinkmaker right away. Please, wait here a while.
say:34:1610715033:1.female: Um... in that case, esteemed guests, I'll send someone to fetch our drinkmaker right away. Please, wait here a while.

say:35:1610715034:1.text: If you find waiting boring, the <style="highlight">grove at the end of the southern avenue</style> has lovely scenery. Perfect for a walk.
say:35:1610715034:1.source_cn: 要是觉得干坐在这里很无聊，<style=highlig...

say:36:1610715035:1.text: The barista suggests a stroll, his words polite yet oddly deliberate. You can't quite place what feels strange about it.
say:36:1610715035:1.source_cn: 酒保以十分谦恭的态度为你们指定了一个散步地点。你觉得有...
say:36:1610715035:1.male: The barista suggests a stroll, his words polite yet oddly deliberate. You can't quite place what feels strange about it.
say:36:1610715035:1.female: The barista suggests a stroll, his words polite yet oddly deliberate. You can't quite place what feels strange about it.

say:37:1610715036:1.text: Perhaps it was nothing, perhaps the grove truly is lovely. Still, something tells you it's time to speak with Evie in private.
say:37:1610715036:1.source_cn: 或许这只是他随口一说的地点，也或许这里真的风景如画。但...
say:37:1610715036:1.male: Perhaps it was nothing, perhaps the grove truly is lovely. Still, something tells you it's time to speak with Evie in private.
say:37:1610715036:1.female: Perhaps it was nothing, perhaps the grove truly is lovely. Still, something tells you it's time to speak with Evie in private.

narration:38:1610715037:1.text: With a shared glance, the two of you slip away from the Enchanted Cup.
narration:38:1610715037:1.male: With a shared glance, the two of you slip away from the Enchanted Cup.
narration:38:1610715037:1.female: With a shared glance, the two of you slip away from the Enchanted Cup.

choice:32:0:1.text: Feels like you're stringing us along.
choice:32:0:1.male: Feels like you're stringing us along.
choice:32:0:1.female: Feels like you're stringing us along.

say:40:1610715018:0.text: This isn't about money... though, how much more are we talking?
say:40:1610715018:0.source_cn: 这不是钱的问题，实在是……唔，你们加得起多少？

say:41:1610715019:0.text: I hate having my wealth questioned. As a noble of Savannah, I may keep a low profile, but I won't tolerate this treatment.
say:41:1610715019:0.source_cn: 我很讨厌有人怀疑我的经济能力。作为赛凡纳贵族出身的学生...

say:42:1610715020:1.text: Ten times, twenty times this sum is nothing to me.
say:42:1610715020:1.source_cn: 这点钱，再加十倍或者二十倍，对我来说也不算什么问题。

choice:16:1:2.text: Just two cups. We'll pay extra!
choice:16:1:2.male: Just two cups. We'll pay extra!
choice:16:1:2.female: Just two cups. We'll pay extra!

say:43:1610715003:1.text: Haha, I'm not surprised. We're popular among students. Hope we live up to the hype!
say:43:1610715003:1.source_cn: 哈哈，本店确实很受学生欢迎，希望也能得到你们的喜欢。
say:43:1610715003:1.male: Haha, I'm not surprised. We're popular among students. Hope we live up to the hype!
